description.subtitle: Nike del Inter-Blue Walking Cap
description.tagline: Estilo deportivo y elegante del Inter
description.intro: Lighten your passion for Inter with this Nike blue cap with Dri-FIT technology. Its adjustable and breathable design accompanies you in your daily days with comfort and style.
key_benefits: Nerazzurri Identity: Inter Shield on the front for an authentic look.
Thermal Comfort: Dri-FIT technology that drives away sweat.
Total Versatility: Perfect for walks, matches or sunny days.
Adjustable design: Rear closure for a custom fit.
Urban aesthetics: Easy to combine with your daily outfit.
